Archive · Catalogue · Definitions and limits

I/O · IAU · IObot

A local text exchange workspace, provisional English-form rune edition, and explicit-command bot. Nothing is uploaded or retained after the page closes.

Text input and output

IAU · runes of English form

IAU is the author's label. This is a new substitution alphabet using Unicode rune characters, not a historical English alphabet or an established IAU standard. Conversion folds English letter case; other characters pass through. Existing rune characters are decoded as English letters.

Keep an original copy if letter case or already-present rune characters matter. Rune appearance depends on the fonts installed on your device.

IObot · local command I/O

This deterministic bot runs only the listed text commands. It has no AI model, shell access, network actions, or autonomous processes. Catalogue results retain their implementation status.

Try find kerot, runes return with care, math gcd 42 30, or bitflip 0 7.
